description: This source file defines the code-behind logic for the LoginPage of an online examination system. It handles user login actions for students and teachers, including database verification for students and a hardcoded check for teachers, and redirects based on authentication results.

classes.name: LoginPage
classes.description: A partial class representing the code-behind for the login page, handling user authentication and navigation logic.

methods.name: loginButton_Click
methods.description: Handles the login button click event, verifies user credentials against database (for students) or hardcoded credentials (for teachers), and redirects accordingly.
